verdict.rationale: The docs describe self-serve pay-as-you-go pricing for all APIs with no subscription, an API key in under 3 minutes, and prepaid API credits, so no sales contact is needed. A public pricing page breaks costs down by search context size, Pro Search and Agent API tool usage, and every response returns exact token counts so per-request cost is visible. missing for 10: the actual per-token/per-request dollar rates are not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation that the pricing is clear.
